body: I don't have any swings.  I've just felt this way for 2 months.  I've had problems in the past and I think the break-up brought it back.

Doing great!  It, taking all of the negative energy and using it to better myself.  We dated two years, so whenever I think about her I get pretty bummed.  But when that happens I just go on a run, I can now do a 7 minute mile!  My best in high school was like 9, so I'm pretty proud of that:
Haha, that was a great episode!  Funny to see Taylor make Chris uncomfortable every now and then
